en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large hilltop castle complex above a river. The foreground features a calm river with a sandy bank and a few people near the water. Behind the river stand several townhouses and smaller buildings along the embankment. Rising above them is a massive Gothic‑Revival castle or palace with steep, patterned roofs, multiple towers, turrets, and a tall church-like spire. One part of the main building appears to be under restoration or construction, encased in a prominent scaffolding structure. Dense trees cover much of the slope up to the castle.
